zh: 第１９０４．１０．２０．９２號所屬之「其他膨潤或焙製之含米量不低於３０％穀類或穀類產品之調製食品，不含肉者」
en: Other prepared foods obtained by the swelling or roasting of cereals or cereal products, containing not less than 30% of rice, not containing meat, of Item No. 1904.10.20.92

zh: 第１９０４．２０．１１．００號所屬之「未經焙製榖類片之調製食品，含米量不低於３０％」
en: Prepared foods obtained from unroasted cereal flakes, containing not less than 30% of rice, of Item No. 1904.20.11.00

zh: 第１９０４．２０．２１．００號所屬之「未經焙製穀類片及經焙製之穀類片或膨潤穀類混合而成之調製食品，含米量不低於３０％」
en: Prepared foods obtained from mixtures of unroasted cereal flakes and roasted cereal flakes or swelled cereals, containing not less than 30% of rice, of Item No. 1904.20.21.00

zh: 第１８０６．９０．９２．００號所屬之「其他由粉、細粒、澱粉或麥芽精製成之調製食品，含米量不低於３０％，含可可重量（以完全脫脂可可為基礎計算）在４０％或以上低於５０％」
en: Other food preparations of flour, meal, starch or malt extract, containing not less than 30% of rice, containing 40% or more but less than 50% by weight of cocoa calculated on a defatted basis, of Item No. 1806.90.92.00

zh: 第１９０１．９０．９１．００號所屬之「其他第１９０１節所屬之含米量不低於３０％調製品」
en: Other preparations of heading No. 19.01 containing not less than 30% of rice, of Item No. 1901.90.91.00

zh: 旅客攜帶自用行李以外之應稅零星物品，郵包之零星物品，除實施關稅配額之物品外，按５％稅率徵稅（海關進口稅則總則五）
en: Except for the products that are subject to a tariff rate quota, dutiable miscellaneous articles besides personal effects carried by incoming passengers and miscellaneous articles imported by postal parcels, are dutiable at the rate 5% ad valorem.
